attempts.summary: Provisioned a fresh 3-member etcd 3.6.10 cluster across node1/node2/node3 (Alpine apk package, OpenRC), loaded application keys, then simulated a permanent, unrecoverable loss of node3's member (stopped etcd, wiped its data directory) while node1/node2 retained quorum and full read/write availability. Performed the standard etcd member-replacement procedure: removed the dead node3 member ID, added a new node3 member, reconfigured node3's conf.yml with initial-cluster-state=existing, and started a fresh etcd process there. Verified the cluster returned to 3/3 healthy started members with synchronized raft indices and all original application keys plus a key written during the outage intact on the rejoined node3. Finally ran the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured baseline boot_ids and etcd/data health on all three nodes, restarted node1, node2, and node3 sequentially (one at a time, native reboot, quorum preserved throughout), polled each until exec access returned, confirmed each node's boot_id changed, and verified full cluster health, 3/3 membership, and complete application data after each restart.
